# Banana AI

> Banana AI is an AI-powered image generation platform that transforms photos into various creative outputs including miniature characters, car models, motorcycle figurines, and other artistic variations. Users can upload images and generate unique AI-enhanced versions across different specialized tools with a simple, credit-based system.

The platform offers multiple specialized AI generators for different subjects - from general miniature creation to specific automotive and motorcycle model generation. Each tool is designed for specific use cases like creating collectibles, 3D printing models, stickers, and digital mockups. Users receive credits to generate images, with automatic privacy protection - all uploaded images are deleted within 7 days and never shared publicly.

Key features include secure image processing, user account management, and AI models designed to refuse generating inappropriate content, ensuring a safe creative environment for all users.

## Documentation

- [Privacy Policy](https://banana-ai.art/privacy-policy): Comprehensive privacy policy covering data handling, image processing transparency, and user rights
- [Terms of Service](https://banana-ai.art/terms-of-service): Service terms including usage guidelines, AI content safety measures, and user responsibilities

## Core Features

- [Home Page](https://banana-ai.art/): Main interface with general AI image generation and processing capabilities
- [AI Miniature Generator](https://banana-ai.art/ai-miniatur): Transform photos into miniature characters and figurines
- [Car Miniature Generator](https://banana-ai.art/miniatura-carro): Create realistic car miniatures for 3D printing, stickers, and mockups
- [Motorcycle Miniature Generator](https://banana-ai.art/miniatur-motor): Generate detailed motorcycle miniature models from photos
- [Authentication System](https://banana-ai.art/): User registration and login system

- [Robots.txt](https://banana-ai.art/robots.txt): AI crawler access configuration
